output_power.note: u-blox TX power limit tables for {variant}

patches.note: build the u-blox table instead of the Realtek default

regulatory.when: after wifi_on(RTW_MODE_STA), i.e. after every Wi-Fi restart
notes: ETSI additionally requires adaptivity. In wifi_set_mib(): wext_set_adaptivity(RTW_ADAPTIVITY_NORMAL), wext_set_adaptivity_th_l2h_ini(242), wext_auto_set_adaptivity(RTW_ADAPTIVITY_NORMAL).
The OEM integrator must not allow the end user to change the channel plan.

mac.source: Realtek eFuse, programmed in u-blox production
notes: No host-side reader is wired up. Print it from the application with wifi_get_mac_address().

permanent.note: wifi_set_mac_address("{mac_hex}") writes the eFuse from the application. eFuse space is limited and the write cannot be undone.

notes: Print array_mp_8721d_txpwr_lmt_type1[] at startup and compare against the u-blox table. See ameba-rtos-d/nora-w30/README.md.
